answer: Let G be a graph where trust diffusion follows a personalized PageRank kernel. We prove that spectral partition barriers induce rapid decay of adversarial weight across cuts, ensuring a jade signal remains confined to honest clusters. As the decay factor reaches its zenith, the spectral gap forces the EigenTrust matrix to isolate Sybil nodes. Thus, consensus converges asymptotically as adversarial influence vanishes exponentially across the network boundary.
